script:
mkdir -p "$F/agent" AID=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-run --tools file_editor --no-autotitle --workspace "$F/agent" --print-id) control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$AID" --name qa-f16-agent --duration 300 control-agent-server conversation send "$AID" --text 'Use the file_editor tool to create the file qa-f16-agent.html in the current working directory containing exactly:

qa-f16-agent

' \ --wait --until finished --timeout 300 control-agent-server ws stop qa-f16-agent --kinds ObservationEvent --contains qa-f16-agent.html --expect-min 1 --wait 20 --save F16.agent-artifact/events control-agent-server api GET "/$AID/workspace/qa-f16-agent.html" --expect 200 --check . contains qa-f16-agent \ --check-header content-type eq 'text/html; charset=utf-8' --save F16.agent-artifact/served test -f "$F/agent/qa-f16-agent.html"
